name: Minding Your Own Business
overview: Scripture warns believers to avoid meddling in matters that do not concern them, likening such interference to grabbing a dog by the ears and inviting trouble (Proverbs 26:17). Instead, Christians are encouraged to focus on their own spiritual growth, removing personal faults before judging others (Luke 6:42). The apostle Paul further instructs the church to accept those weak in faith without engaging in divisive disputes, recognizing that each servant stands before their own Master, God, who sustains them (Romans 14:1, 4). This teaching promotes peace and quietness over unnecessary conflict and vexation of spirit (Ecclesiastes 4:6).
